card: Backports four pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch for the 32.2 point release. It stops established sockets using select() from waking on exceptional conditions like TCP urgent data, fixes cross-architecture Guix build configuration failures, isolates depends local package tarballs in WORK_PATH to prevent collisions across checkouts, and handles mainnet node logs cleanly in combine_logs.py. All constituent changes are already merged on master.
changed_since_previous: Added the backport of #36716 (restricting select() error set handling to connection establishment) and updated the v32.x release notes.
evidence: Commit fe4101248d (#36716): 'With select(), sockets waited on without ErrorEvent no longer wake up for or report exceptional conditions, such as TCP urgent data on an established connection.'

Commit baf46aa6c1 (#36709): 'guix shell loads the manifest before it applies --system, so a --system=aarch64-linux build on an x86_64 machine configured the aarch64 toolchain with --build=x86_64-guix-linux-gnu, and gcc-cross failed to configure.'
Commit 76b0e368ce (#35765): 'when SOURCES_PATH is shared between checkouts, a checkout can find another checkout's tarball, see no newer files, and build from the wrong sources.'
problem: The 32.x maintenance branch contains several bugs already fixed on master: established sockets using select() can wake up or report errors on unexpected conditions like TCP urgent data; checkouts sharing SOURCES_PATH in depends can build against stale or wrong local package tarballs; cross-architecture Guix builds fail during gcc-cross configuration; and combine_logs.py raises an unhandled exception when parsing mainnet node logs.

risk.why: Touches core socket polling and event handling across platforms as well as depends build scripts; a mistake in socket logic could lead to connection drops or missed I/O wakeups on platforms relying on select().

scope_notes: Standard maintenance release backport PR cherry-picking commits that already landed on master into the 32.x release branch.
summary: Backports four merged master pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch for the 32.2 point release. The included patches restrict select() error set monitoring to connection establishment, store depends local package tarballs in WORK_PATH to prevent checkout collisions, fix Guix build triplet evaluation during cross-architecture builds, fix mainnet log parsing in combine_logs.py, and update release notes.
